stories.title: 聯儲 10–2 票維持利率 3.75%–4.00%
stories.title_en: Fed Holds Rates Steady at 3.75%-4.00% in 10-2 Vote
stories.summary: 多數票暫停加息；兩名委員反對要求加息。會議後 BTC 曾跌穿 $80k，加密市場出現約 $3.35 億清算。
stories.summary_en: Fed held 3.75%–4.00% in 10-2 vote; BTC dipped below $80k with ~$335M crypto liquidations.
stories.why_it_matters: 宏觀決議直接驅動弱市閘；利率／清算潮期間應優先半倉同避高槓杆叙事。

stories.title: Franklin Templeton 推兩隻「股息買 BTC」混合 ETF
stories.title_en: Franklin Templeton Launches Bitcoin-Equity Hybrid ETFs on Nasdaq
stories.summary: 10/29 FBEQ／FIBT 上市：約 95% 美股＋5% 比特币，股息自動再投入 BTC；費率約 0.09%／0.19%。機構又多一條「被動加碼 BTC」通道。
stories.summary_en: FBEQ/FIBT listed Oct 29: ~95% U.S. equities + 5% Bitcoin with dividends reinvested into BTC; fees 0.09%/0.19%.
stories.why_it_matters: 傳統資金持續把 BTC 當配置；弱市閘仍要睇 breadth／現貨，唔好當 ETF 上架＝即日爆升。

stories.title: zkLink Nova 橋被攻擊，約 $78.6 萬被抽走
stories.title_en: Attacker Drains $786,000 from zkLink Nova Ethereum Bridge
stories.summary: 10/28 攻擊者經公共 relayer 注入偽造 batch root，從 L1 escrow 提走約 22.43 ETH 等；團隊暫停出塊／提款，開 20% 白帽賞金。
stories.summary_en: Oct 28 exploit via forged batch root drained ~$786k; zkLink paused production/withdrawals, offered 20% white-hat bounty.
stories.why_it_matters: 跨鏈橋仍係高風險；模擬倉唔跟橋相關新幣，亦提醒用戶撤銷不明授權。

stories.title: 鏈上拆穿網紅「月賺廿萬」：跟單多數蝕
stories.title_en: X Users Expose Memecoin Trading Myths on Pump.fun
stories.summary: 有人模擬跟網紅 15 個叫單，$100 持有變 ~$54–89；另見串行部署者一日發幾百個幣、成功率 <1%。Pump.fun 跟單獎勵被指助長洗版。
stories.summary_en: Simulated follows of an influencer's 15 calls turned $100 into ~$54–89; serial deployers launch hundreds/day with <1% success.
stories.why_it_matters: 直接支持「紙上倉＋捕捉率」實驗：KOL 截圖唔等於可複製勝率；洗版標籤同避開名單要繼續硬。

stories.title: Ondo 喺 Solana 推 BlackRock 策略代幣組合
stories.title_en: Ondo Finance Launches BlackRock-Powered Portfolios on Solana
stories.summary: 七個 Intelligent Portfolios 上 Solana（含三個 BlackRock 模型），合資格非美用戶可當單一代幣轉帳；建基於鏈上約 $5 億既有資產。
stories.summary_en: Seven Ondo Intelligent Portfolios on Solana incl. BlackRock model strategies for eligible non-U.S. investors.
stories.why_it_matters: RWA／機構產品分流資金；爆升表仍應分開「現貨急升 meme」同「長線叙事幣」，唔好混一齊跟買。

stories.title: 網紅 Mika 誤貼私鑰，$MIKA 開發錢包被掃約 $4 萬
stories.title_en: Crypto Influencer Mika Accidentally Posts Private Key, Loses $40K
stories.summary: 10/28 發幣時貼錯私鑰，約 5 億枚 $MIKA 秒被搬走換約 380 SOL（~$4 萬）。鏈上量急升急跌，社區爭論係失手定操作。
stories.summary_en: During an Oct 28 memecoin launch, influencer Mika pasted a private key; ~500M $MIKA (~380 SOL / $38–40K) drained in seconds.
stories.why_it_matters: 紙上跟買亦要當私鑰／合約地址係高風險；名人發幣唔等於安全，合約同金鑰操作失誤會即時爆倉。

stories.title: DTCC 開通約 $30 萬億證券代幣化服務
stories.title_en: DTCC Launches Tokenization Service for $30 Trillion in Securities
stories.summary: 10/28 上線：DTC 託管證券嘅數碼孿生，首批約 34 隻合資格標的（羅素 1000／ETF／美債等）；JPM、Citi、Fidelity 等已加入。
stories.summary_en: DTCC Tokenization Service live Oct 28 for digital twins of DTC-held securities (~$30T eligible set).
stories.why_it_matters: 華爾街基建上鏈屬長線叙事；對當日 meme 捕捉率影響有限，但可解釋資金偏好「合規資產」多過山寨。

stories.title: 俄羅斯央行批出首個加密交易所自律組織
stories.title_en: Russia Registers First Self-Regulatory Body for Crypto Exchanges
stories.summary: 10/29 批 NAUFOR 監管加密所／數字存管；註冊營運商須 90 日內加入，資本門檻起跳約 1500 萬盧布。
stories.summary_en: Bank of Russia approved NAUFOR as first SRO for crypto exchanges/depositories; operators must join in 90 days.
stories.why_it_matters: 各地合規框架加快會影響跨境流動；策略面仍以 Binance 公開數據為準，唔靠單一國政策炒。

stories.title: 英國 FCA 迫 HTX（前 Huobi）撤出至 2031
stories.title_en: FCA Secures Settlement Forcing HTX Out of UK Market
stories.summary: 10/29 高院和解：禁向英國消費者推廣至 2031；停新開戶／入金，現有用戶被引導提款。海外所合規壓力再加。
stories.summary_en: FCA High Court settlement bars HTX from promoting to UK consumers until 2031; no new sign-ups/deposits.
stories.why_it_matters: 監管收緊會改流動性同上架池；我哋紙上盤只跟 Binance 公開 USDT 現貨，要留意下架／地區限制外溢。

stories.title: 美現貨 BTC ETF 連續三日淨流入，BlackRock 帶頭
stories.title_en: BlackRock Bitcoin ETF Leads $137 Million Inflows on October 28
stories.summary: 10/28 美現貨 BTC ETF 淨流入約 $1.37 億（三日累計近 $4.24 億），IBIT 幾乎包辦；ETH ETF 同日流出約 $2140 萬。
stories.summary_en: U.S. spot BTC ETFs ~$137M net inflow Oct 28 (~$424M over 3 days), mostly IBIT; ETH ETFs ~$21.4M outflow.
stories.why_it_matters: 機構吸 BTC、山寨失血時弱市閘應保持；半倉規則同廣度檢查比「ETF 流入」口號更實際。

stories.title: $LAUNCH 一小時急崩九成，疑似 rug
stories.title_en: $LAUNCH Token Crashes in Alleged Rug Pull
stories.summary: 自稱改進 Pump.fun 嘅 $LAUNCH 曾觸 $400 萬市值，10/28 一小時內暴跌；兩錢包提前套現，社區指開發者舊案重演。
stories.summary_en: $LAUNCH hit ~$4M then crashed >90% Oct 28; two wallets cashed out early; community alleged repeat rug pattern.
stories.why_it_matters: 新 launchpad 幣極易一日內歸零；模擬倉跟買應避開「平台幣／自家盤」同開發者可任意撤帳嘅項目。

stories.title: CFTC 主席暢想「智能雪櫃自己炒幣買餸」
stories.title_en: CFTC Chair Envisions Fridge Trading Crypto for Groceries
stories.summary: 10/28 Frontier Forum：Selig 談 AI agent 可持倉、交易甚至發 meme；問邊個註冊、邊個負責，會唔會要「know-your-agent」。
stories.summary_en: At Oct 28 CFTC Frontier Forum, Selig floated AI agents holding/trading crypto and launching memecoins; raised registration/liability questions.
stories.why_it_matters: 監管開始認真睇 AI 交易代理；我哋紙上策略要保持可解釋規則，唔好變成黑箱跟單。

stories.title: Solana RWA 突破 $51.9 億新高
stories.title_en: Solana Real-World Assets Hit $5.19 Billion Milestone
stories.summary: rwa.xyz 顯示 Solana 代幣化資產創新高，僅次 Ethereum／BNB；同日官帳同 Polygon 互相 mute／block 玩梗。
stories.summary_en: Solana RWA ATH ~$5.19B per rwa.xyz; playful X spat with Polygon same day.
stories.why_it_matters: 公鏈資金向 RWA 傾斜時，meme 流動性會更薄；early-gainer 要更嚴控流動性同洗版門檻。

stories.title: PEPE 對 BTC 兩年跌勢疑似打破，巨鯨增持
stories.title_en: PEPE Meme Coin Breaks Two-Year Downtrend Amid Whale Buys
stories.summary: PEPE 約 $0.00000493、市值 ~$20.7 億、24h 量逾 $8 億；傳 Justin Sun 相關錢包提走約 $5100 萬。波動仍大。
stories.summary_en: PEPE near $0.00000493 (~$2.07B mcap, >$800M vol); wallets tied to Justin Sun withdrew ~$51M.
stories.why_it_matters: 大型 meme 反彈會搶走小市值注意力；捕捉率對照仍要以當日頭 20 急升為準，唔好跟單「已經爆完」嘅藍籌 meme。

stories.title: 神秘巨鯨五日沽逾 100 萬 SOL（約 $1.04 億）
stories.title_en: Solana Holds Near $100 After Whale Sells $104 Million in SOL
stories.summary: 鏈上見錢包日均約 20 萬 SOL 入幣安／Kraken；SOL 10/29 曾跌穿 $100 後企穩，市場同時受 ETF 外流同弱勢拖累。
stories.summary_en: ~200k SOL/day to Binance/Kraken over ~5 days (~$104M); SOL dipped below $100 then stabilized Oct 29.
stories.why_it_matters: 大戶分批出貨會壓制 Solana meme 熱度；early board 要避免把「鏈上掉血」當入場確認。

stories.title: 比特币波動率跌至 2023 年夏低位附近
stories.summary: Glassnode 顯示一個月已實現波動約 25%，近 2023 年中；BTC 徘徊 $80–81k，聯儲維持利率後壓縮波動，市場等下一次大變動。
stories.summary_en: 1-month realized vol ~25% (Glassnode), near mid-2023; BTC ~$80–81k after Fed hold.
stories.why_it_matters: 低波動常預示大方向選擇；跟買批次更要跟緊 BTC／廣度，唔好喺壓縮期加大槓杆式注碼。

stories.title: 假 Trust Wallet 卡網站釣魚，連錢包即被掃
stories.title_en: Fake Trust Wallet Card Sites Drain User Funds
stories.summary: 冒充 Trust Wallet 推「無 KYC 金屬卡／8% cashback」誘人連錢包；官方否認關係，研究員提醒只經官方渠道。
stories.summary_en: Phishing sites mimic Trust Wallet card offers; connecting wallets drains funds; official account denied affiliation.
stories.why_it_matters: 釣魚網站同假空投一樣常見；任何「連錢包領卡／空投」對模擬倉用戶都係即時紅旗。

stories.title: Bloom 交易 Bot 漏洞：約 94 秒掃走近 $95 萬 SOL
stories.title_en: Solana Wallets Drained in Bloom Trading Bot Hack
stories.summary: 10/26 第三方模組 RCE，約 49 個地址、9408 SOL（~$95 萬）被掃；團隊其後暫停服務並承諾全額退款。
stories.summary_en: Oct 26 third-party RCE drained ~9,408 SOL (~$953k) from ~49 addresses; Bloom paused and pledged refunds.
stories.why_it_matters: 交易 Bot／授權係常見攻擊面；紙上實驗用戶亦應分倉、撤銷舊授權，唔好把熱錢包當長期倉。
